title: The Last Horizon Revisited
author: Bram Ishikawa
blurb: Ada Pemberton, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
